go_test_uncached.key_output: FAIL borsterminal/backend/internal/snapshot 601.622s | panic: test timed out after 10m0s | goroutine in golang.org/x/crypto/scrypt.smix <- aead.dev/minisign.EncryptKey <- snapshot.TestSigner_EncryptedPrivateKey (signer_test.go:205) | all other packages ok
go_test_uncached.why_environmental: TestSigner_EncryptedPrivateKey runs minisign's encrypted-key KDF (scrypt, N=1048576, r=8 => 1 GiB allocation, three times). On this 1-CPU/3.88 GB host with 0.18 GB free at run time, and with npm ci + vitest + the data lane running concurrently, the first EncryptKey call alone had not finished at the 600 s default. The same package passes in the cached `go test ./...` run on identical sources, and the isolated rerun below passes in 169 s. Real code/test regression: none.

go_race.reason: no gcc on this host (`gcc --version` -> command not found); `-race` needs a C toolchain. CI is the evidence for the race build.
